title: Audio Cue
description: Something that HAPPENS to the sound: an ordered list of steps, plus the events that fire it on their own. Steps run in groups split at every `wait`; steps in one group start together, so 'the sting and the theme hit on the same beat' is the default rather than the exception. One file per cue in data/audio/cues/, filename = id. Validated at load time by module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/audio-director.mjs#validateCue, which is the authority if these disagree.

title.description: What the GM sees on the desk's cue list.

triggers.description: Events that fire this cue without anyone pressing anything. A field that is present must match exactly; a field left out matches anything.

scene.description: A Scene's repo id, Foundry id or name.

actor.description: The Actor id of whoever takes the stage.

do.description: music: play a pool or a named track. ambience: set the beds. soundscape: apply a whole one. sting: fire a one-shot. mix: move the GM's faders. wait: pause before the next group. at-marker: run steps when the music reaches a named moment. banner/handout: put something on screen, on each client's own beat. macro: an escape hatch.

duck.description: How far the beds dip under this sting.

marker.description: A named moment inside the track (data/audio/review.json).

then.description: Steps to run when the marker arrives. Markers may not be nested inside markers.
